mechanism: Vitamin C (ascorbic acid) enhances calcium absorption by maintaining acidic pH in the gastrointestinal tract and forming soluble complexes with calcium, potentially increasing calcium bioavailability and risk of hypercalcemia with chronic use.
action: Monitor serum calcium levels in patients taking both agents chronically, especially those with renal impairment or concurrent use of other calcium sources; separate administration by 2 hours may reduce interaction magnitude.
